name: nova-studio
description: Nova Studio — unified governed IDE shell for SkillzMcGee

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const d=p.join('dist');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css']){fs.copyFileSync(p.join('public',f),p.join('dist',f));}console.log('built dist/');"
